title: Add option to execute a user command before switching to an activity
line: Scripts placed in an activity's new "activating" and "deactivating" folders now run and finish before Plasma switches to or away from that activity.
explanation: kactivitymanagerd's RunApplication plugin already starts the files in ~/.local/share/kactivitymanagerd/activities/<id>/activated and deactivated, but only after CurrentActivityChanged, detached, so a script that unlocks or syncs the new activity's files always runs too late. The Activities module now emits an internal (not on D-Bus) currentActivityAboutToChange signal right before it changes the current activity. The plugin handles it with a direct connection and runs the executables in the old activity's deactivating folder and the new activity's activating folder one by one, waiting for each (up to a minute) before the switch goes on.

commits.message:
runapplication: run scripts that finish before switching activities

Scripts in the activated and deactivated folders of an activity only
start after the switch, so they can't prepare what the activity needs.
Executables in new activating and deactivating folders now run first.

BUG: 393603

media.caption: Master: a script that shows an "unlocking the Project vault" dialog sits in Test2's activated folder (the only hook today). Clicking Test2 switches to the orange desktop first, then the dialog appears
With the change, the same script in Test2's activating folder: the dialog appears while the blue Default desktop is still current, and the switch to orange happens only after Unlock is clicked
Master: the script runs after the switch (already on Test2's orange desktop)
With the change: the script runs first, Default's blue desktop is still current
